gloss: to dodge; to evade; to sidestep; to deflect

definitions.gloss: to dodge; to evade (a physical attack)
definitions.explanation: To move out of the way of an oncoming object or attack — a punch, ball, vehicle, or similar. Implies quick, deliberate avoidance rather than passive escape.

definitions.gloss: to deflect; to dodge (a question, responsibility)
definitions.explanation: To avoid an awkward question, criticism, or unwanted topic by giving a vague or off-topic response. The figurative extension of the physical dodge.

notes:
Transitive godan verb (intransitive pair: かわる is unrelated; this verb stands alone). The kanji form {躱|かわ}す exists but is uncommon — usually written in kana. Both physical and figurative senses are extremely common.

TRANSITIVITY:
- {〜を}かわす: to dodge X (always transitive)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{攻撃|こうげき}→攻撃：02748_kougeki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かわす: to dodge an attack
- ⟦パンチ→パンチ：11258_panchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かわす: to dodge a punch
- ⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かわす: to deflect a question
- ⟦{追及|ついきゅう}→追及：09148_tsuikyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かわす: to dodge investigation/probing
- ⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かわす: to evade responsibility

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{避|さ}ける→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧: to avoid — broader; can mean staying away from something in advance
- ⟦{逃|に}げる→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧: to flee — to run away; かわす implies dodging while staying in place
- かわす (⟦{交|か}わす→交わす：19373_kawasu⟧): a homograph in kanji meaning "to exchange (words, glances)" — different verb
